payload.title: Audit public frontier as mechanisms, not a pipeline
payload.decision: Do not reproduce or ingest the current public 6.40-6.83/P100 composite stack. Keep unknown-license artifacts, train-only formations, exact visible-well overlap, probe/canary bias constants, and score-directed branch shifts out of the prize pipeline. After independently verifying E011, test only clean-room PF seed-cloud uncertainty, bounded continuity, and prefix-GR well-bias hypotheses in fresh preregistered experiments.
payload.rationale: Exact source and output audits show the apparent frontier is a family of forks sharing pretrained artifacts, guarded same-well contact reconstruction, public overlap calibration, and score-specific constants. The 6.40 overlap layer acts only on the three visible wells; P100 moves one visible well by +2 ft; the public GBDT gate fails its own OOF check. These notebooks provide mechanism leads but no clean causal route to the current 5.265 top-five cutoff.
payload.revisit_trigger: A source-audited notebook supplies reproducible full grouped OOF and hidden-scale runtime from legal inputs without public overlap, opaque artifacts, train-only formations, or score-derived constants.
